data.name: ConnectionSubtitle
data.value: A private route for the apps you choose.

data.name: ImportDescription
data.value: Copy your personal connection link from your SLX account. Importing links this Windows installation to the device.

data.name: ImportFootnote
data.value: Your link is private. It is encrypted on this computer and is never included in diagnostics.

data.name: NoSubscription
data.value: Add a link to get started.

data.name: ExpiryUnknown
data.value: The server did not provide an expiry date.

data.name: AutoProfile
data.value: Hysteria2 is preferred; VLESS is an alternative.

data.name: ProfileAdvanced
data.value: If a method does not work, select another here.

data.name: ModeSelectedDescription
data.value: Enabled apps use VPN. Shared Windows DNS can also affect other apps while VPN is recovering.

data.name: ModeWholeDescription
data.value: Internet on your whole PC uses VPN. Local networks stay available.

data.name: NoAppsDescription
data.value: Add a browser, messenger or another .exe. Nothing is selected automatically.

data.name: AppsSubtitle
data.value: Turn VPN on for specific apps. Your list stays on this computer.

data.name: RulesNotice
data.value: App changes apply to new connections without restarting the VPN. An existing session may need the app to reconnect.

data.name: AppLimitations
data.value: Desktop .exe apps are supported. Launchers, protected apps and Store apps may need additional setup. Per-app DNS isolation is not guaranteed.

data.name: DiscoveryDescription
data.value: Available running apps in this Windows session. You can also select an .exe file.

data.name: NothingRunning
data.value: No suitable running apps found. Select an .exe instead.

data.name: SettingsSubtitle
data.value: Changes to appearance do not interrupt your VPN.

data.name: AutoStart
data.value: Launch SLX when I sign in to Windows

data.name: AutoStartHint
data.value: SLX starts in the system tray. Set VPN startup behavior below.

data.name: MinimizeTray
data.value: Keep running in the tray when I close the window

data.name: MinimizeTrayHint
data.value: Use Exit in the tray menu to disconnect and quit.

data.name: RemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove this link from this computer? This does not revoke the device in your account.

data.name: HelpSubtitle
data.value: A few simple steps if something is not loading.

data.name: HelpReconnectBody
data.value: Reconnect in SLX. If that does not help, refresh your subscription and try the alternative connection method in Settings.

data.name: HelpAppsTitle
data.value: An app still uses the old route?

data.name: HelpAppsBody
data.value: Fully close and open that app, or restart its connection. Existing connections may keep their previous route.

data.name: HelpBindingBody
data.value: An existing Happ link belongs to that installation. Create a separate Windows device or transfer the connection in your SLX account. SLX never copies Happ’s device identity.

data.name: SecurityNote
data.value: No browsing telemetry. Connection data is encrypted by Windows. If VPN fails, protected public traffic stays blocked until recovery. Disconnect releases protection. Local networks remain available; per-app DNS isolation is not promised.

data.name: AlphaNotice
data.value: Preview release. Real tunnel, DNS, sleep recovery and clean-machine acceptance are still being verified.

data.name: ServiceHelp
data.value: Install SLX using its installer, then try again. Do not run the app as administrator.

data.name: NoActiveApps
data.value: Choose at least one app, or switch to Entire computer.

data.name: FaultDeviceBound
data.value: This link is already linked to another installation. Open your account to transfer it or add a Windows device.

data.name: FaultAccess
data.value: Access is unavailable, expired or linked to another installation. Open your account to check access or transfer a Happ connection.

data.name: FaultUrl
data.value: Enter a full HTTPS subscription link from slxvpn.com.

data.name: FaultNetwork
data.value: Could not reach SLX. Check your internet connection and retry. Your previous subscription is saved.

data.name: FaultSubscription
data.value: SLX could not read this subscription. Refresh it in your account or contact support.

data.name: FaultProfile
data.value: This connection method is not supported by this version.

data.name: FaultStorage
data.value: Windows could not open protected settings. Check your Windows account or contact support.

data.name: FaultUnknown
data.value: The operation could not be completed. Retry or contact support.

data.name: FaultCancelled
data.value: The request was cancelled. A link may already be bound; retry the same link if needed.

data.name: FaultOwner
data.value: Another Windows user owns the active connection. Disconnect in that account first.

data.name: FaultCore
data.value: The VPN engine is unavailable or could not start. Reinstall SLX or contact support.

data.name: Imported
data.value: Subscription added. Choose apps and connect.

data.name: StatusStale
data.value: Status could not be refreshed. Connection state is unknown.

data.name: NoMetrics
data.value: Connection status is checked by the SLX service.

data.name: FaultOtherVpn
data.value: Another SLX tunnel adapter is already present. Disconnect the previous session before trying again.

data.name: FaultServiceSecurity
data.value: SLX could not verify access to its local service. Restart the app or repair it using the official installer. Do not run this app as administrator.

data.name: FaultSessions
data.value: Only one signed-in Windows user is supported in this preview. Sign out of other sessions first.

data.name: ServiceRequestHelp
data.value: The service could not accept this request. Update the app and service using the same installer.

data.name: ServiceContactHelp
data.value: Could not reach SLX. Disconnect requests VPN shutdown and removal of its traffic protection.

data.name: ServiceUnknownHelp
data.value: No reply in time. Disconnect requests VPN shutdown and removal of its traffic protection.

data.name: ExitUnknownBody
data.value: SLX could not confirm that the VPN stopped. It may still be running. You can cancel and retry, or close only this app without claiming the VPN is off.

data.name: QuickAppsHint
data.value: Add detected apps right away. For other apps, choose their .exe.

data.name: QuickAppsEmpty
data.value: No matches in the available list. Try another name or choose the .exe manually.

data.name: DiscoveryUnavailable
data.value: Could not refresh the app list. You can choose an .exe manually.

data.name: CachedProfiles
data.value: Saved settings are available. Use Refresh to update the subscription.

data.name: FaultCleanup
data.value: Windows is still finishing VPN disconnection. Wait a few seconds and try connecting again.

data.name: RulesUnconfirmed
data.value: The application of these changes has not been confirmed yet.

data.name: TrafficProtected
data.value: Protection is on. If VPN drops, protected traffic stays blocked until recovery. Use Disconnect to turn protection off.

data.name: FaultStartup
data.value: Could not configure SLX startup. Check Windows startup settings and try again.

data.name: UpdatesPrivacy
data.value: Checks at startup and every 6 hours. Only public SLX releases; your app list and subscription are never sent.

data.name: UpdateNotChecked
data.value: New versions have not been checked yet.

data.name: UpdateFound
data.value: Download the update, then choose when to install it.

data.name: UpdateCurrent
data.value: You have the latest available version.

data.name: UpdateCheckFailed
data.value: Could not check for new versions. Try again later.

data.name: UpdateInstallHint
data.value: Confirm installation in Windows. Your settings are preserved.

data.name: UpdateDisconnectFirst
data.value: The update is downloaded. Disconnect VPN and wait for confirmation before installing.

data.name: UpdateReady
data.value: Update downloaded and checked. Ready to install.

data.name: UpdateInstallerOpened
data.value: Installer started. SLX is closing; reopen the app if you cancel installation.

data.name: UpdateInstallCancelled
data.value: Installation was cancelled in Windows. You can start it later.

data.name: UpdateIntegrityFailed
data.value: File verification failed. Installation is blocked; download the update again.

data.name: UpdateActionFailed
data.value: Could not prepare or open the update. Try again later.

data.name: FaultTrafficProtection
data.value: Could not apply traffic protection rules. Try again; if this persists, copy diagnostics from Help.

data.name: FaultTrafficMissing
data.value: A selected app executable is missing. Open Applications, remove its old entry and add the current app. Discord and Roblox paths are checked automatically before connecting.

data.name: FaultTrafficDenied
data.value: Windows denied access to a selected app executable. Check that it is accessible or add its current .exe in Applications.

data.name: DiagnosticsPrivacy
data.value: Only Windows and SLX versions, service state and error codes. No private link, servers or app list.

data.name: DiagnosticsCopied
data.value: Diagnostics copied. You can send them to support.

data.name: DiagnosticsFailed
data.value: Could not access the clipboard. Try again.

data.name: StatusOperationUnconfirmed
data.value: Action not completed. Checking the connection state.

data.name: AutoConnectStartup
data.value: Connect VPN when SLX starts with Windows

data.name: AutoConnectStartupHint
data.value: SLX waits for its service and saved subscription, then connects. A manual disconnect prevents another automatic attempt.

data.name: AutoConnectNetworkWait
data.value: Automatic connection is waiting for an available network. Check your internet connection if the wait continues.

data.name: ServiceStartupHelp
data.value: Windows is still preparing the network. SLX will check its service automatically. If the wait continues, open Help.

data.name: RemoveBlocked
data.value: The VPN state is not confirmed yet, so the link stays on this computer. Disconnect VPN or wait until the SLX service responds, then try again.

data.name: FaultOutboundInterface
data.value: No usable Windows route to the VPN server. Check your internet connection and network adapters, then retry.

data.name: FaultVpnProbe
data.value: The VPN connection check failed. Check your internet connection or try the other connection method.

data.name: FaultEndpointNetwork
data.value: Could not resolve the VPN server address. Check your internet connection, then retry or choose the other connection method.

data.name: FaultEndpointRejected
data.value: The VPN server address failed validation. Refresh your subscription or contact support.

data.name: FaultRuntimeValidation
data.value: The VPN engine files could not be verified. Repair SLX using its official installer.
